deficiencies.description: The rewrite transforms a reference to something the audience previously saw into a factual statement about the pre-cancerous states being present.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You saw those different pre-cancerous states.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The different pre-cancerous states are present,

deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds the phrase "Of the screening methods discussed", which restricts the scope of the lecturer's claim without a source in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So screening, as I said, the cervix is best.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Of the screening methods discussed, cervical screening is the best.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite clarifies an unclear or incomplete statement by explicitly designating the showing of symptoms as an example of "some other reason".
deficiencies.sourcePassage: or there's some reason if you're showing symptoms.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: or some other reason, such as the patient showing symptoms.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite changes a causal link ("so"), which indicates that the unnecessary treatment results in a high cost, into a definitional link ("which is").
deficiencies.sourcePassage: so a very, very high cost.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: which is a very high cost.

considerations.sourcePassage: and very likely to probably already be malignant.
considerations.reason: Dropping 'probably' from the double hedge 'very likely to probably' is an allowed change, as 'very likely' retains the scientific hedge.

considerations.sourcePassage: already potentially shedding cells for invading into other parts of the body.
considerations.reason: Changing 'for invading' to 'that invade' is an allowed grammatical improvement with the exact same meaning.

considerations.sourcePassage: a very, very high false positive rate.
considerations.reason: Dropping the repeated word 'very' is an allowed change.
